title: spec/automation: an app cannot provision one position per external party at runtime — positions are metadata, flows cannot create them, and the system-flow assignment path is the bypass #25251 closes
body:
Ruled: 6377886479 · batch #9 item 1 (#25496, 6377842908) · letter B · 2026-10-24T00:43:45Z (folded into #25234: roster record + `membershipKeys` per supplier, no position per party; closed as duplicate)

Filed from the objectstack-ai/hotsrm v0.2 (supplier portal) platform evaluation, 2026-10-23, spec 18.0.0. Related: #25233 (external organisation role), #25251 (system flows writing `sys_user_position`).

## The pattern an SRM portal needs
Row-level isolation per supplier company: one position `srm_vendor_<no>` per supplier, a `portal_position` field on every portal-visible object, and an RLS policy `portal_position in current_user.positions`. The evaluation measured this pattern working: supplier A and B cannot see each other, a direct id read answers 404.

## What was measured
- The position itself is metadata. An admin can create it at runtime with `PUT /meta/position/:name`, but a flow has no action that creates a position, so the app cannot provision it when a supplier passes admission.
- Assigning the position from a `runAs: 'system'` flow by writing `sys_user_position` works today, but #25251 reads that write as a bypass of the delegated-administration gate and asks for it to be refused or judged. Once it lands, the app has no path for the assignment either.
- Result: onboarding an external party is a two-step manual process (admin creates the position, then someone assigns it), for every supplier.

## Wanted
~~A governed, app-authorable way to do both steps, for example:~~
~~- a flow action `createPosition` / `assignPosition` whose writes pass the ADR-0090 D12 gate judged as the flow's owner, with `granted_by` stamped, and whose target position must sit under an app-declared template (`srm_vendor_*`), or~~
~~- a declarative "position per record" binding on an object (each `srm_supplier` row owns a derived position, created and retired with the row), which is the whole need in one declaration.~~

(Ruled B: the need is met by #25234's declarative membership keys — the roster object carries `membershipKeys`, supplier isolation is RLS over them, no position per supplier; ruling 6377886479.)

## Acceptance
A supplier record reaching status `approved` results, without an administrator acting, in a position that exists, is assigned to the supplier's portal users, and whose grant is stamped and within the app's declared template; deleting or blacklisting the supplier retires it.

Dedupe words: position per record runtime provisioning flow createPosition assignPosition portal isolation external party sys_user_position governed path.
